nasaplus.scope: Complete current public NASA+ videos and series taxonomy. Publisher access is checked when you play.

archive.scope: Current selections from five licensed collections; not the entire Archive.

nfb.scope: Free public film entries at build time; the official embedded player enforces current access and region.

pbskids.scope: Current PBS KIDS homepage editorial selection, only publisher-enabled viral embeds; not the entire PBS KIDS library.
pbskids.embedPermission: Official viral player config allow_embed=true AND is_playable=true, with generated Embed UI confirmed on example3103689019.

newson.selection: Complete advertised live directory plus fresh-resolving latest-newscast cards only where a current supported guest offer was confirmed. No expiring clip or playback URL is persisted.

xumo.source: Xumo current public website regional live directory
xumo.advertising: Fresh publisher SSAI offers and full ad query parameters retained; no client VMAP or tracking URL is supplied by the current live offer.

cw.source: The CW current public web live directory
cw.countrySource: The CW US web-service lineup; no per-channel international rights or country override is asserted.
cw.advertising: Fresh publisher fast_params and all offered SSAI stream queries retained. Preplay, client preroll, subscriber and protected modes are excluded.

yupptv.source: YuppTV current public free guest guide
yupptv.countryRule: Explicit source-mapped channel IDs only; viewer country and language are never used as channel country.
yupptv.advertising: Fresh publisher preUrl/preRollUrl via Google IMA; unsupported required schedules are refused.
yupptv.publicRestProtocol: Authorized public page/content and page/stream endpoints; no encrypted web-envelope configuration is required.
yupptv.playbackScope: Directory availability is checked again on play. Region, access, clear-HLS availability and advertising can change.

worldtv.name: World TV — official broadcasters
worldtv.scope: Curated selection of 7 official broadcaster live players; not a complete country or IPTV-org lineup.
worldtv.countryBasis: Broadcaster headquarters or national identity from the linked primary source; not viewer IP, language or programme location.
worldtv.refresh: Maintainer-only metadata refresh. Al Jazeera’s stored live embed ID may change; no real-time freshness is claimed. Euronews uses its stable publisher alias. YouTube oEmbed validates the existing approved reference and owner only; it does not discover a fresh live ID or prove current live availability. Stored video IDs can change and need a maintainer source/browser check.

broadcasters.embedSupport: Publisher-owned live page Share > Embed control

broadcasters.name: TRT World
broadcasters.embedSupport: Publisher-owned live page Share > Embed control

broadcasters.name: NHK WORLD-JAPAN
broadcasters.embedSupport: Publisher-owned live page Share > Embed control
broadcasters.lastObserved: publisher standby between scheduled news bulletins

filmzie.source: Complete Filmzie public MOVIE and TV_SHOW directories with all published seasons reconciled against current episode details
filmzie.countrySource: No catalogue country is supplied; real publisher guest offers determine current availability without country overrides.
filmzie.advertising: Fresh original public VMAP URL and all returned breaks are passed to Google IMA. Only current CPM main-feature HLS offers are accepted.
filmzie.scope: Complete supported public movie and series directories, all published seasons and currently listed guest episode metadata. Current free CPM playback and all publisher advertising/access restrictions are checked again when you watch.

redbull.label: Official film selection
redbull.scope: Current films linked by the publisher editorial Films collection; not the entire Red Bull TV library.
redbull.playback: Per-title VideoObject.embedUrl. The original publisher iframe controls fresh offers, advertising, regional availability, captions and consent.

roku.label: Free movies and shows - Watch on Roku
roku.scope: All enabled free movies and parent-free show cards discovered in the supported browse graph. Not a verified whole-service total. Complete episode files are optional; other shows open their publisher page.
roku.playback: Explicit official Roku player links. Roku controls current availability, access, captions and advertising.

philo.source: Ordinary Philo Watch Free guest UI; complete Guide traversal; only explicit Free channels group headers admitted.
philo.scope: The current free live channel guide, not Philo’s on-demand library or paid plans. Playback stays on the official channel page.
philo.access: No email, account credentials, payment details or trial submitted. Philo creates its ordinary temporary uncredentialed guest session.

fawesome.source: Fawesome public Movies navigation and its supplied weekly shelf
fawesome.scope: The complete current Fawesome This Week movie shelf, not the whole Fawesome library. Playback remains in the official publisher player.
